linkage.method: Register coordinate is inside the upper mapped ground-mounted solar footprint. Matching municipality. Only one active ground-mounted solar register unit within 2 km of shown rows.

limitations: Register point links the registered ground-mounted unit to the displayed location, but register supplies no polygon or assignment of all three mapped rows.
Module count is a register value; rendered subdivision remains schematic.
Mapped footprint areas and area per module provide a plausibility check only; no power capacity is inferred from them.
Capacity is for the located register unit, not total site PV capacity. Weather model uses the municipal reference profile, not a measured park forecast.
